messages:
Maya: Quick design check 1h: proposing a compact right-rail 'Starter chooser' that expands into the setup checklist instead of the full-width quickstart banner. Less noise, still persistent. Thoughts? Kevin: I like less top-level clutter. Concern: discoverability for non-technical roles on small orgs. Maybe show compact rail for orgs >1 seat and full banner for single-seat signups? Olivia: I mocked both in Figma: https://figma.com/file/mno123/starter-chooser-rail — collapsed rail, expanded chooser, and mobile fallback (full-width). Ben: From research, PMs say "starter" is clearer than "sample"; devs prefer "sample" or "repo". We should map copy by role: PMs->"Start from template", Devs->"Add sample project", Ops->"Apply workspace template". A/B test labels. Nina: Accessibility: if the rail expands inline we must move focus into the expanded panel and announce it. Also add a skip link back to main content for keyboard users. Sam: aria-bot suggestion: use role="region" with aria-label="Starter chooser" for expanded panel, set aria-expanded on the toggle, and use an aria-live="polite" SR-only region for import status updates. Avoid adding dynamic content without announcements. aria-bot: Scan: recommend visible focus rings, ensure color contrast of CTA >= 4.5:1 in both themes, and include aria-controls on the toggle button. Sam: Small snippet we can reuse: ```html
``` Kevin: Telemetry plan: EXP-900. Track control_opened (rail|banner|first-run-checklist), label_variant (template|sample|starter), and target (import|upload). We'll use this to decide persistent surface. Olivia: Dedicated/Private variant: swap 'Add sample' with 'Upload template' + link to docs for air-gapped registries. Can't call hosted registry in those orgs. Ben: For usability, I'll run 6 moderated sessions split across roles (2 dev, 2 pm, 2 infra) focusing on language and the discoverability tradeoff. Hoping to have results next Tues. Maya: Good. Also proposal: show contextual helper text under labels for first-timers: "Installs a demo app into your workspace". Hide after first use. Sam: Keyboard shortcut discussion: expose in command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K) rather than single-letter inline. That keeps discoverability without accessibility conflicts. Nina: Microcopy variants for experiments board: V1: "Start from template" / helper "Starter apps and integrations"; V2: "Add sample project" / helper "Demo app for this workspace"; V3: "Starter app" / helper "Quick start with a prebuilt app". Kevin: I'll wire EXP-900 and ensure mobile fallback metric. Also add a small success toast that updates SR-only region with 'Starter app added to workspace'. Olivia: I'll update the Figma with ARIA notes and the three copy variants. Will prototype the expand + focus animation for quick usability testing. Maya: Action items: Olivia update mocks + prototype, Kevin create EXP-900 + telemetry keys, Sam add ARIA acceptance criteria to the PR checklist, Ben run usability sessions, Nina finalize copy matrix. We'll reconvene after the research notes. :+1:
